briefings.title: Mark Pincus unpacks his "Proven, Better, New" framework (with Reid Hoffman) | Masters of Scale
briefings.tldr: To build successful consumer products, entrepreneurs must isolate innovation using the "Proven, Better, New" framework, ruthlessly test ideas to build a "failure machine," and prepare for a highly democratized consumer AI era where taste and rapid iteration supersede traditional development cycles.

briefings.title: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe on the R2, robotics & the future of EVs | Masters of Scale
briefings.tldr: Rivian Founder and CEO RJ Scaringe outlines how the electric vehicle maker navigates extreme operational complexity through distributed decision-making, its strategic $5.8 billion software partnership with Volkswagen, and an aggressive expansion into autonomous driving and industrial robotics.

briefings.title: CEO Jason Robins on DraftKings’ next big bets | Masters of Scale
briefings.tldr: DraftKings CEO Jason Robins details the company’s evolution from a fantasy sports startup to a $13 billion gaming leader, focusing on the strategic shift toward live betting and prediction markets while utilizing AI to enhance responsible gaming protocols.
